headline: Wilson sails to Europe, a presidential first
post_facts: First sitting president to visit Europe
Nine days at sea to France
He pushed for a League of Nations

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen eighteen... President Woodrow Wilson sailed for France.

scenes.label: Woodrow Wilson
scenes.caption: On the bridge of the George Washington
scenes.title: A first for a president
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] No sitting president had ever traveled to Europe before.

scenes.label: at sea aboard the George Washington
scenes.text: [calmly] His ship, the George Washington, spent nine days at sea.

scenes.label: U.S. Atlantic Fleet
scenes.caption: Navy ships, December 1918
scenes.title: Shaping the peace
scenes.text: [warmly] He went to help shape the peace after World War One.

scenes.title: The Senate said no
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] He pushed for a League of Nations... but the Senate rejected the treaty.

scenes.title: Would you have made that trip?
scenes.text: [gently] Would you have made that trip?
